story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Are any of your children musical like...?
N-, well, they may be. Uh my son has some drums, but uh, and I asked him if he wanted to take lessons and he said, “No,” so, we don’t force him...
To not play, but he was interested in journalism at the time. So, as long as he’s happy...
It’s okay, and uh my older son, he’s a disabled veteran from the Vietnam War. Um my daughter passed last year...Iqbal, yeah. So, that’s where that is.
